tasks.title: Backend: add produced quantity per intermediate to explode response
tasks.description: BomExploder currently tracks 'batches' (runs) per intermediate recipe but the /recipes/{id}/explode response doesn't expose the resulting output quantity. Add produced_quantity (batches * recipe output_quantity) per intermediate in BomExploder::explode() and RecipesController::explode(), so the API can express 'ran recipe X N times, producing Y units'.

tasks.title: Backend: order intermediates by build tier
tasks.description: Intermediates in the explode response are currently sorted alphabetically by item name. Reorder them so lower-tier recipes (those with no intermediate dependencies, e.g. base reactions like Sulfuric Acid) come before recipes that consume them, so the list reads as an actual bottom-up build sequence.
tasks.notes: Added a 'tier' field per intermediate (0 = consumes only base materials, else 1 + max tier of its intermediate inputs), computed in BomExploder::tierOf() via memoized recursion over the recipe cache. RecipesController sorts by tier asc then item_name asc. Verified against Laser Focusing Crystals explode: Nitrogen Fuel Block (tier 2) -> Sulfuric Acid/Rolled Tungsten Alloy (tier 3) -> Tungsten Carbide (tier 4), matching the known reaction chain.

tasks.title: Frontend: display runs -> produced quantity per recipe
tasks.description: Update recipe-calculator.ts/.html to show the new produced_quantity field per intermediate (e.g. 'run the Sulfuric Acid reaction 5 times, resulting in 1000 Sulfuric Acid'), replacing or supplementing the current 'Batches Run' / 'Leftover' columns with this runs-per-recipe framing. Update ExplodeIntermediate model in recipe.model.ts accordingly.
tasks.notes: Added produced_quantity and tier to ExplodeIntermediate in recipe.model.ts. Replaced the 'Intermediates & Leftovers' table in recipe-calculator.html with a 'Build Steps' ordered list phrased as 'Run the X recipe N time(s), resulting in Y X' (plus leftover noted parenthetically when > 0), relying on the backend's tier-sorted order. Frontend dev server rebuilt with no errors; user to verify visually at /recipes/21/calculate.

next_session_suggestions: Start with task #1 (backend produced_quantity field) since #2 and #3 build on it.
